title: BotRunRecord
description: A single bot execution run record with performance and identity metadata

id.description: Unique identifier of the bot run record

userName.description: Username of the Control Room user who ran the bot

firstName.description: First name of the user who ran the bot

lastName.description: Last name of the user who ran the bot

email.description: Email address of the user who ran the bot

hostName.description: Hostname of the Bot Runner device where the bot executed

iPAddress.description: IP address of the Bot Runner device

fileName.description: Name of the bot file that was executed

startTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bot execution started

endTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bot execution ended

status.description: Final execution status of the bot run

totalLines.description: Total number of task lines executed during the run

successIndicator.description: Whether the bot run completed successfully
